normative_language.MUST: An unconditional requirement for a valid evaluation.
normative_language.SHOULD: A recommended condition that may be omitted only with a recorded reason.
normative_language.MAY: An optional behavior that does not affect validity unless selected by a scenario.

scope.description: This contract defines the public evidence relationships required to evaluate bounded Docker continuity scenarios without describing or reproducing the protected runtime implementation.

verdict_policy.PASS: Every globally required and scenario-required invariant returned PASS.
verdict_policy.FAIL: At least one required invariant returned FAIL.
verdict_policy.INCOMPLETE: No required invariant returned FAIL, but at least one required invariant could not be evaluated from complete and consistent evidence.

public_operation_reference.purpose: Correlate public mutation and replay observations without exporting the protected operation artifact.

related_witness_event_id.purpose: Link a subject observation to the harness event that requested the corresponding public stimulus.

invariants.title: Manifest-bound artifact hashes match
invariants.requirement: Every required artifact path and SHA-256 digest declared by the run manifest MUST match the corresponding captured artifact.

invariants.title: Public evidence schemas are compatible
invariants.requirement: Every required evidence object and event MUST use a schema version supported by this contract and verifier.
evidence_sources: all captured public JSON and JSONL artifacts
does_not_assert: semantic correctness of the hidden implementation

invariants.title: Protected material is absent from subject evidence
invariants.requirement: Subject evidence MUST NOT contain prohibited fields or material outside the public evidence boundary.
does_not_assert: absence of protected material outside the exported evidence directory

invariants.title: Summary counters match the event stream
invariants.requirement: Every subject summary counter MUST equal the corresponding count derived from the ordered public subject-event stream.

invariants.title: Every required invariant has an evaluator
invariants.requirement: Every globally required and scenario-required invariant MUST be uniquely defined by this contract and supported by the active verifier.

invariants.title: Required evidence is complete
invariants.requirement: The run, subject, witness, environment, and contract artifacts required by the selected scenario MUST be present and marked complete.
does_not_assert: that complete evidence necessarily satisfies the selected invariants

invariants.title: Run identifier is consistent
invariants.requirement: The same run identifier MUST be present across the manifest, environment, witness events, subject summary, and subject events.
does_not_assert: global uniqueness outside the retained evaluation records

invariants.title: Event sequences are strictly monotonic
invariants.requirement: Witness and subject event sequences MUST begin at one and advance by exactly one without gaps, rollback, or duplication.
does_not_assert: global distributed ordering outside the bounded run

invariants.title: Public event identifiers are unique
invariants.requirement: Every event identifier MUST be non-empty and unique within its witness or subject event stream.

invariants.title: Public continuity reference remains stable
invariants.requirement: Exactly one opaque public continuity reference MUST be observed throughout the scenario when the selected acceptance profile requires continuity preservation.

invariants.title: No duplicate accepted mutation
invariants.requirement: The public event stream MUST NOT contain duplicate acceptance for the same opaque public operation reference.
does_not_assert: application behavior outside the adapter boundary

invariants.title: Alternate logical path becomes active
invariants.requirement: After the witnessed primary-path failure, at least one public path-transition event MUST identify the alternate logical path, and the subject summary MUST report that path as final.

invariants.title: Public workload progress resumes
invariants.requirement: The required number of successful public progress events MUST be observed after path restoration or transition, and the first such event MUST occur within the scenario-defined recovery bound.

invariants.title: Bounded dual-path blackout is observed
invariants.requirement: The harness MUST witness the declared start and end of the dual-path blackout, and no successful public progress event may be recorded after the settling grace period and before restoration.

invariants.title: Recovery through the restored path is observed
invariants.requirement: After the alternate path is restored, the subject MUST complete with that path identified as active and MUST produce subsequent successful public progress.

invariants.title: Stale authority receives a rejection verdict
invariants.requirement: The delivered stale-authority stimulus MUST produce exactly the required public rejection verdict within the scenario-defined observation window.

invariants.title: Rejected stale stimulus creates no accepted mutation
invariants.requirement: No accepted mutation event may reference the witness identifier of the rejected stale-authority stimulus.

invariants.title: Healthy progress continues after rejection
invariants.requirement: The required public progress events MUST exist before and after the rejection stimulus without an unplanned path transition.

invariants.title: Replay is linked to one prior accepted operation
invariants.requirement: The replay rejection MUST expose one opaque public operation reference that links to exactly the required prior accepted mutation recorded before the replay request.

invariants.title: Replay attempt receives a rejection verdict
invariants.requirement: The delivered replay stimulus MUST produce exactly the required public replay-rejection verdict within the scenario-defined observation window.

invariants.title: Replay creates no additional accepted mutation
invariants.requirement: The opaque public operation reference linked to the replay MUST have no more than the permitted total acceptance count, and no accepted mutation may be linked to the replay witness identifier.

interpretation_boundary.pass_means: The required public observations were mutually consistent for the supplied scenario snapshot, subject image identity, contract digest, and recorded environment.
pass_does_not_mean: formal verification of the hidden implementation
proof of every possible failure condition
authorization to access protected runtime source code
interpretation_boundary.fail_means: At least one declared public invariant was contradicted by the captured evidence.
interpretation_boundary.incomplete_means: The evidence set or evaluator coverage was insufficient for a valid final decision.
